ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: Figure A is a contour topographic map of a sea island. The north arrow points toward the top of the map, so the right side of the map is east. The location marked "2" is located on the right-side coast of the island, namely the east coast. In Figure B, the Sun is located near the sea horizon, with an obvious reflection above, indicating that the shooting direction is toward the sea. Then reason: Shooting toward the sea at location 2 is mainly toward the eastern sea surface. The Sun in the photo appears above the sea horizon, which should correspond to the Sun over the eastern sea surface, and most accords with the morning period after sunrise. Beijing time 17:30 is already near evening, and the Sun should be in the western sky, so it cannot appear in a photo facing the eastern sea surface at location 2. Therefore, the shooting time least likely to be Beijing time is 17:30.
